compiled_state.title: check-corpus-schema.py ignores per-subdirectory _schema.yaml files during full-corpus validation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Bug Report

**Priority**: 3 (normal)
**Zero Inference Rule**: Directly observed in diff for PR #337 by FP-recovery opus review.

## Observed behavior
check-corpus-schema.py loads a single schema from the corpus_dir argument and reuses it for every recursively-discovered .yaml file. When the hook runs against the top-level ui-reference/ directory, only _schema.yaml is loaded; principles/_schema.yaml and _schema-anti-patterns.yaml are skipped via _SKIP_NAMES and their narrower vocabularies / additional required fields are never enforced.

## Expected behavior
Per-subdirectory schemas (_schema-anti-patterns.yaml etc.) are either enforced for their subdomain or documented as informational-only.

## Fix
Option A: Update the validator to walk per-subdirectory schemas (like check-corpus-schema.sh does for single-file invocations).
Option B: Delete the unused subdirectory schemas and document that the parent schema is authoritative.
Option C: Add a comment to each per-subdirectory schema marking it as informational-only.

comments.body:
Investigation complete (inline, PATH B — investigation-only mode).

ROOT CAUSE: check-corpus-schema.py main() loads a single schema at startup (line 229) and applies it to ALL recursively-discovered .yaml files. Per-subdirectory _schema.yaml files (principles/_schema.yaml) and parent-level named schemas (_schema-anti-patterns.yaml) are skipped from corpus entry validation but never loaded to validate their respective subdirectory entries.

HYPOTHESIS TESTS:
- HT1 CONFIRMED: domain=auth in principles/ entry → PASS with top-level schema, FAIL with principles/_schema.yaml
- HT3 CONFIRMED: anti-patterns entry missing rule_id → PASS with top-level, FAIL with _schema-anti-patterns.yaml

PROPOSED FIX: Resolve schema per-entry-directory in the main() loop. Check: (1) entry.parent/_schema.yaml, (2) corpus_dir/_schema-{parent.name}.yaml, (3) fall back to top-level. Cache by dir.

RED TEST: test_subdir_schema_enforced_over_toplevel_schema in tests/scripts/test_check_corpus_schema.py — entry with domain value valid in top-level but invalid in subdir schema must exit non-zero.
